owner.description: Full instance control. Owner RBAC permissions are always granted; reading direct messages still requires participation.

admin.description: Advanced delegated administration of settings, channels, roles, permissions, accounts and audit tools. This is not equivalent to ownership.

moderator.description: Moderates public channels by deleting messages, removing or banning members and locking discussions. Does not manage accounts or roles and does not purge history by default.

helper.description: Helps members and can be mentioned for assistance. No moderation or administration power by default.

everyone.description: All authenticated users and their ordinary inherited permissions.

moderator.title: Moderator
moderator.description: Delete other users' messages, remove or ban channel members, and lock discussions without managing accounts or roles.
moderator.default_description: Moderates public channels and community conduct.

helper.title: Helper
helper.description: Identify people who assist the community. Adds no moderation or administration power.
helper.default_description: Helps members find answers and use the community.

custom.title: Custom
custom.description: Start without additional permissions and configure every decision manually. Members still inherit ordinary access.

permission_descriptions.room_remove_member: Remove an explicit member from a channel without banning them. They may rejoin if allowed.
permission_descriptions.room_lock: Lock or unlock new activity in channel rooms.
permission_descriptions.room_purge_messages: Permanently erase message-owned channel history while preserving the room.
permission_descriptions.room_bypass_lock: Add permitted content while a channel is locked.
permission_descriptions.message_delete_others: Delete other users' messages without being able to rewrite them.

create.title: Create a grade
create.subtitle: Choose a safe starting point, then review the exact permissions before creating the grade.
create.starting_point_description: Templates add only the permissions listed below. Ordinary member access is inherited separately.
create.advanced_description: You can fine-tune server, group and channel decisions after creation.
create.permission_setup_failed: The grade could not be fully configured and was removed. Try again.
create.template_changed: The suggested identity was updated for the selected template.
create.member_inheritance_note: Every assigned user also keeps permissions inherited from Members.

overview.title: Roles and permissions
overview.subtitle: Define team responsibilities without granting more power than necessary.
overview.moderator_summary: Channel moderation without account or role administration
overview.members_summary: Ordinary permissions inherited by every authenticated user
overview.owner_summary: Full RBAC authority; direct-message reading still requires participation
